description: Scala source file providing utility functions for converting Kafka TopicPartition objects and offsets to and from JSON strings, used within Spark Kafka integration.

classes.name: JsonUtils
classes.description: Object containing utility methods for serializing and deserializing Kafka TopicPartition objects and offsets to JSON.

methods.name: partitions
methods.description: Reads JSON string to produce an array of TopicPartition objects.

methods.name: partitions
methods.description: Serializes an iterable of TopicPartition objects into a JSON string.

methods.name: partitionOffsets
methods.description: Reads JSON string to produce a map of TopicPartition to offset.

methods.name: partitionTimestamps
methods.description: Reads JSON string to produce a map of TopicPartition to timestamp.

methods.name: partitionOffsets
methods.description: Serializes a map of TopicPartition to offset into a JSON string.

methods.name: partitionTimestamps
methods.description: Serializes a map of TopicPartition to timestamp into a JSON string (currently same as partitionOffsets).
